title: A username newtype
description:
Write `struct Username(String)` with:

- `Username::new(text: &str) -> Result<Username, String>`: the text is trimmed and lower-cased; it must then be 3 to 16 characters of `a`–`z`, `0`–`9` or `_` (otherwise `Err` with a message).
- `impl Deref for Username` with `Target = str`, so a `&Username` can be used wherever a `&str` is expected.
- `impl Display` that prints `@name`.
hints: With `type Target = str;` and `fn deref(&self) -> &str { &self.0 }`, `&Username` coerces to `&str`, and every `str` method (`starts_with`, `len`) works on it.
